svg.aria-label: Roadmap: fourteen built boxes in two rows, then seven planned items in order, and where research and build differ
svg.text: SOLID = BUILT · DASHED = PLANNED, IN ORDER
No rebuild, no large refactor. Where research and build disagree it is in the tuning layer: thresholds, model, how to get spoiler-safe character knowledge.
The refinements that followed the demo: the character's own knowledge and the story clock; then the pipeline read once.
